problems: The active official site exposes an aging technical surface: the response identifies PHP 5.6.36 and the page contains many legacy HTTP links/assets from an HTTPS homepage.
The homepage is a dense WordPress-style portal with duplicated navigation, generic 'Clique Aqui/Acessar' actions and weak prioritization between appointment, specialties, convenios and exam results.
The key appointment action is not explained as a single journey; users see WhatsApp, contact, lab results and legacy HTTP routes competing for attention.

The site publishes strong operational proof—two Bigorrilho units, 30+ specialties, 24+ convênios, hours and medical director—but the hierarchy buries that proof, creating plausible search and scheduling ROI.
rebuild_angle: Reframe the clinic as a coordinated care network: appointment first, then specialty/insurance fit, then the nearest Bigorrilho unit and exam follow-up.
concept_thesis: This concept can only belong to Centro Médico Adventista Curitiba because it organizes the verified promise of 30+ specialties, 24+ convênios, two Bigorrilho units and lab follow-up into a calm care-network map rather than an interchangeable clinic landing page.
concept_rules: Use a care-network map composition with two unit anchors and a central appointment node, not a generic hero plus cards.
Preserve the Adventist logo and blue/green clinical palette; add a warm sand background only to distinguish patient guidance from utility actions.
Use a trustworthy grotesk sans with measured weights and wide spacing; keep medical information highly scannable rather than ornamental.
Use the official logo, official clinic/news imagery and unit/map cues only; no invented physician portraits or outcomes.
Make appointment the primary conversion, with explicit secondary routes for convênios, specialties, exam results and contact.
On mobile, keep a visible appointment action and compress specialties/convênios into searchable or grouped sections while preserving both unit addresses and hours.
active_evidence: Official HTTPS homepage returned HTTP 200 and rendered on 2026-07-18; page publishes 30+ specialties, 24+ convênios, two Bigorrilho units, clinic/lab hours, WhatsApp appointment and the medical director.
